card.name: Inside long chemical and drug names
card.fires_on: Pieces partway through long chemical or drug names, such as imidazolidinylidene, hydroxyimino, uridine, ursodiol, benzimidazole and estriol. It also fires on a few stray spots such as a space between numbers.

modes.label: Chemical name pieces
modes.description: A middle piece of a long systematic or compound drug name, right before the rest of the name continues.

modes.label: Benzimidazole class
modes.description: The start of benz before imidazole when naming a drug class.
modes.example: hypersensitivity to the<< benz>>imidazole class of compounds or any components

modes.label: Stray connecting spots
modes.description: Occasional plain words or spaces in dosing or interaction sentences.
modes.example: leading<< to>> lower estrogen reabsorption and reduced efficacy

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long chemical names, where the name is only half spelled out.
